source: COMPREHENSIVE_PLAN_FOR_REAL_TIME_WRIGHT_FLYER_SIM_WITH_FRANKENSIM.md §4.4/§4.5 (ROUND 6 steady state; preimage closure externally audited Rounds 5-6)
freeze_semantics: Fields listed here are the v1 contract. Any change mints a v2 schema id beside this one; v1 is never edited in place. Rust types + identity-authorities.json registration land with the first executing consumer (E3.2/E5.1) and must transcribe THIS artifact.

run_identity_basis_v1.note: Minted only AFTER prelaunch closes and the mode-complete tick-0 state is frozen (accepted_tick0_state_digest exists then).

formulas.RunId: H('fs-flyer/run/v1', RunIntentId, InputTraceId) — the closed two-input definition; NEVER 'hash of the quintuple' (self-referential)
formulas.RunAnchor: Intent(RunIntentId) | Final(RunId) — active subordinate objects bind the anchor; final persisted objects mint new final ids; no provisional identifier is ever relabeled
formulas.RunSpecId: H('fs-flyer/run-spec/v1', pre-execution projection of RunIdentityBasisV1 fields existing at minting time + InputPolicyId) — cache key only, excludes accepted_tick0_state_digest
formulas.InputTraceId: hash of InputTraceV1 { input_trace_schema_id, end_tick_exclusive, ordered ResolvedAppliedEvent(channel, applied_tick, ordinal_within_tick, quantized_value) } — trace EXTENT is part of the domain; acquisition-clock metadata lives ONLY in the replay attachment
formulas.FieldQueryId: H('fs-flyer/field-query/v1', FieldSourceSnapshotId, components, grid, induction_approximation, field_backend_id, precision, derivative_and_masking_profile)
formulas.PresentationId: H('fs-flyer/presentation/v1', presentation_schema_id, canonical(asset manifest, camera configuration, render configuration, audio configuration))
formulas.PhysicalUncertaintyRealizationId: pure function of (physical distribution, realization seed, PhysicalRealizationAlgorithmId) — NOT ArtifactId, so binary rebuilds preserve CRN wind realizations
formulas.ModelUncertaintyRealizationId: pure function of (model-uncertainty spec, realization seed, ModelRealizationAlgorithmId) — the single authoritative preimage

leaf_identity_closures.PhysicalRealizationAlgorithmId: content hash of the canonical physical-realization algorithm manifest: algorithm name+version, StationaryOuPathV1 anchor constant, modal-basis construction id, stream partition map, quantization rules
leaf_identity_closures.ModelRealizationAlgorithmId: same shape for the model-uncertainty realization algorithm (residual-coefficient draw method, hinge-friction draw method, ...)
leaf_identity_closures.InputPolicyId: content hash of { input_trace_schema_id, InputTransducerMode + parameters, device-mapping table id, quantization rules, LateInputPolicy }
leaf_identity_closures.PilotPopulationHypothesisId: content hash of the pilot-population distribution artifact + pilot/day/flight dependency-structure declaration (PhysicalScenarioId ingredient)
leaf_identity_closures.PerceptionModelId: content hash of { cue-set declaration, per-cue delay/noise/filter parameters, occlusion-geometry abstraction id, PerceptionSchedule, causal-order convention } (ModelId ingredient)
leaf_identity_closures.FieldBackendId: content hash of { backend kind (cpu-wasm | webgpu-v1.5), kernel version, precision profile, masking profile } (FieldQueryId ingredient)
leaf_identity_closures.BladeCollisionProxyArtifactId: content hash of { source blade-geometry artifact (E1.6), construction algorithm version, capsule count/rails/radii, cover-error certificate }
leaf_identity_closures.EvidenceLineageId: content hash of { source_artifact_ids[], derivation_steps[], independence_group, permitted_claims[], forbidden_claims[], calibration_or_holdout, convention_uncertainty }

uncertainty_separation: Physical uncertainty (wind, temperature, pilot mass, sourced geometry variation) and model uncertainty (section residuals, hinge friction, wake closure) are SEPARATE identity-bound realizations; both enter RunId via the basis, but only physical uncertainty belongs to the reconstructed scenario distribution — model deficiency can never masquerade as weather. Pilot allocation: population hypothesis → PhysicalScenarioId; member draw incl. remnant realization → PhysicalUncertaintyRealizationId; perception/controller algorithms → ModelId; residual deficiency draws → ModelUncertaintyRealizationId. A single undifferentiated pilot_effect field is FORBIDDEN.
replay_envelope_v1_fields: conventions_block (axes, handedness, moment signs, reference areas, span/semispan definitions, units schema, floating-point + deterministic-math profiles)
input_acquisition_trace ATTACHMENT (device_sample_time, requested_tick, applied_tick, late_by_ticks, sequence_number, input_transducer_mode)
event_refusal_log (liftoff, saturations, separation transitions, wake-mode events, contact, touchdown, QoS attachments)
checkpoint_cache_exclusion_rule: A cache may be excluded only after a checkpoint/resume hostile twin proves its deterministic rebuild reproduces every subsequent subsystem digest.
replay_attachment_rule: Presentation quality, QoS transitions, device metadata, and field queries are replay ATTACHMENTS, excluded from RunId unless they altered the applied input trace.
migration_semantics: Migrations parse old envelopes, mint new identities, preserve originals, and state which semantics changed — never silently reinterpret an old replay under new physics.

archive_contract.ratified_vendors: Cloudflare R2 Standard content-addressed serving primary (native prefix-scoped bucket locks after promotion — R2's S3 API does NOT implement AWS object-lock headers) + AWS S3 Standard with versioning + Object Lock compliance mode in a SEPARATELY ADMINISTERED account as WORM mirror
archive_contract.git_carries: signed trust roots, manifests, indexes, small schema fixtures only (no LFS production binaries)
archive_contract.publication: VERIFIER-MEDIATED dual publication: independent uploads, read-back size+BLAKE3 verification, retention controls, then TUF targets publication — never provider-native replication; source deletions never propagate
archive_contract.encryption: SSE-S3 on the mirror unless independently escrowed KMS retention exists (a deleted KMS key makes locked objects unreadable)
archive_contract.signing: TUF-style roles: offline threshold root, delegated targets, short-lived timestamp, snapshot metadata, rollback/freeze protection — BLAKE3 is content identity, not publisher authenticity
archive_contract.vendor_swap: only via a written equivalence receipt (failure/admin domains, immutable retention, conditional create, multipart integrity, audit export, retrieval, regions, budget); S3 API compatibility alone is not equivalence
archive_contract.cost_basis: ~1 TiB dual-stored ≈ $39/month (planning estimate, re-verify at provisioning — E0.9b)

no_claims: This artifact freezes CONTRACTS. It does not claim any executing implementation, registered identity authority, or provisioned archive; those are E0.9b/E0.9c and the E3.2/E5.1 consumers.
